defects.finding: P2.1 b9_payoff.state_change and global local_payoff guarantee a dated log entry and mentor-relationship shift even though the fresh-setup branch can consume reporting time and fail to produce a reviewed entry.
defects.required_change: Make b9 state_change and global local_payoff explicitly branch-conditional. A completed durable log, mentor acknowledgment, relationship/access shift, and milestone eligibility exist only if the chosen branch actually produces and gets review of a legible entry before closure. Permit legitimate outcomes of stronger evidence but no completed log, contradicting evidence with only a partial note, or an unreviewed result.

defects.finding: fresh_setup_retest.local_payoff_if_earned currently guarantees some logged result despite the branch's own time-risk mechanics.
defects.required_change: Separate evidence earned from logging earned. A fresh retest may strengthen, weaken, or contradict the anomaly; logging/acknowledgment is a second condition that may fail if time runs out. Do not guarantee any durable record from the retest branch.
